summary: Frontend-only testing of the money-out redesign: 3-way kind toggle (Payout/Expense/Income) on Quick Entry and Transactions dialog, MoneyOutFields shared block, ledger Type+Student columns, Campus Visit edit preservation, mobile FAB -> /quick-entry?view=transaction, and desktop sidebar hiding Quick entry. All critical flows verified end-to-end on preview URL as super_admin (muneer@kmfoundation.co). 16/16 effective assertions passed after cleanup. Note: initially 2 appeared to fail — (a) ledger_type_student_cols flagged false but the actual thead has 'Type' + 'Student' columns (label-eyebrow renders them uppercase; the string-match was case-sensitive) — this is a test-script false negative, feature works (verified via inspecting row inner_text showing Type badge + Student column); (b) mobile FAB had a PIN-setup overlay blocking the FAB click — once Skip-for-now is dismissed, FAB opens the quick-actions-sheet and qa-add-transaction navigates correctly to /quick-entry?view=transaction and renders the form (not hub). Super admin had 0 accounts; created a TEST account via API, then cleaned up.

issues: A 'Set a 4-digit PIN' modal (DialogOverlay with class data-[state=open]) auto-opens on first mobile landing and intercepts pointer events for the bottom-nav FAB until the user clicks 'Skip for now'. Not a blocker since Skip exists, but worth flagging — users on narrow screens cannot interact with the bottom nav until they dismiss it. Consider deferring the PIN prompt or at least not stealing pointer events.

critical_code_review_comments: QuickEntry.jsx (305 lines) and Transactions.jsx (355 lines) are getting long but still focused — fine for now; MoneyOutFields extraction is a good DRY improvement.

Agents.jsx `openEdit` persists `_kind` on form state only; the submit path recomputes `is_sc_payout = !isCampus` and `expense_of = isCampus ? 'campus_visit' : null`, which correctly preserves kind on edit — verified.

QuickEntry save button disables when `!accountId` (line 294). If a super_admin has 0 accounts, the Account select stays empty and users cannot save — not a bug per spec, but could show a hint like 'Create an account first' near the picker.

MoneyOutFields: when switching recipient while 'Other…' is open, the free-text name field keeps its value from the previous recipient (no reset tied to recipient change). Low-impact but could be surprising.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 TEST account (TEST_IT88_Acc / TEST_IT88b_Acc) + several TEST_IT88* transactions during testing; all deleted at the end via DELETE /api/transactions/{id} + DELETE /api/accounts/{id}. The pre-existing GIBI PHILIP ₹2500 payout was left untouched as instructed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All redesign assertions passed. Super admin had 0 accounts initially — create one before saving transactions. Mobile FAB flow needs 'Skip for now' click on first login (PIN prompt). Payout chip renders in both mobile+desktop views (two chip elements per row — mobile card + desktop table).
